question: Which products have the worst return rates?
interpretation: Return rate = returned items / items not cancelled. Require a minimum volume, otherwise products with two sales dominate the ranking. Rank categories and brands before individual products.
sql:
SELECT p.category, p.brand,
  COUNTIF(i.status != 'Cancelled') AS items,
  COUNTIF(i.status = 'Returned') AS returned,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(i.status = 'Returned'), COUNTIF(i.status != 'Cancelled')), 3) AS return_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = i.product_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING items >= 30
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 20
report_guidance: Rank with volumes shown and state the minimum volume used. Note that recent orders may not have been returned yet, so the latest weeks understate the rate.
